cc:Work.dc:title: OOD steering endpoint cosine
cc:Work.dc:description: Source-selected directions are applied to eng-french without refitting. Bars include every frozen autoencoder plus the factor-aligned mean-difference and matched-norm random controls. Each grey tick is the matched no-steering endpoint cosine. Purple hatching denotes SSAEs, teal hatching denotes SAEs, and neutral hatching denotes controls; pattern identifies the model variant. † clean lexically disjoint OOD; ‡ overlapping-vocabulary pair-mixture diagnostic. LLMs are not pooled.
